records.literal_gloss: Oracle. [The] word of Yahweh concerning Israel. Declaration of Yahweh, stretching out [the] heavens, and founding [the] earth, and forming [the] spirit of humankind within him:

en.L: An oracle. The word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} concerning Israel. Declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who stretches out [the] heavens and founds [the] earth and forms the spirit of {{gender:a person|man}} within {{gender:them|him}}:
en.B: An oracle. The word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} concerning Israel. This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} declares, who stretches out the heavens, lays the foundations of the earth and forms the human spirit within each person:
en.R: This is a message from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} about Israel. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} stretched out the sky and laid the foundations of the earth. He gives each person a spirit within them. This is what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says:

fr.L: Oracle. Parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} concernant Israël. Déclaration {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, qui déploie [les] cieux et fonde [la] terre et forme l’esprit de {{gender:l’être humain|l’homme}} au-dedans de lui :
fr.B: Oracle. Parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} concernant Israël. Voici ce que déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui déploie les cieux, pose les fondations de la terre et forme l’esprit humain au-dedans de chacun :
fr.R: Voici un message {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} au sujet d’Israël. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a déployé le ciel et posé les fondations de la terre. Il donne à chaque personne un esprit au fond d’elle-même. Voici ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit :

es.L: Oráculo. Palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} acerca de Israel. Declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que extiende [los] cielos y funda [la] tierra y forma el espíritu del {{gender:ser humano|hombre}} dentro de él:
es.B: Oráculo. Palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} acerca de Israel. Esto afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que extiende los cielos, pone los cimientos de la tierra y forma el espíritu humano dentro de cada persona:
es.R: Este es un mensaje {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} acerca de Israel. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} extendió el cielo y puso los cimientos de la tierra. Él da a cada persona un espíritu dentro de sí. Esto es lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dice:

vi.L: Sấm ngôn. Lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} về Y-sơ-ra-ên. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, Đấng giương các tầng trời ra, lập nền trái đất, và tạo nên thần linh của con người ở bên trong người:
vi.B: Sấm ngôn. Lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} về Y-sơ-ra-ên. Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán, là Đấng giương các tầng trời, đặt nền trái đất, và tạo nên tâm linh con người ở bên trong mỗi người:
vi.R: Đây là sứ điệp của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} về Y-sơ-ra-ên. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã giăng bầu trời ra và đặt nền móng cho trái đất. Ngài ban cho mỗi người một tâm linh ở bên trong. Đây là điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán:

sw.L: Unabii. Neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kuhusu Israeli. Asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, anayezitandaza mbingu na kuiweka misingi ya dunia na kuiumba roho ya mwanadamu ndani yake:
sw.B: Unabii. Neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kuhusu Israeli. Hivi ndivyo asemavyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, anayezitandaza mbingu, anayeiweka misingi ya dunia, na anayeiumba roho ya binadamu ndani ya kila mtu:
sw.R: Huu ni ujumbe kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kuhusu Israeli. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alizitandaza mbingu na kuiweka misingi ya dunia. Yeye humpa kila mtu roho ndani yake. Hili ndilo {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} analosema:

ko.L: 신탁. 이스라엘에 관한 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀. 하늘을 펴시고 땅의 기초를 놓으시고 사람 속에 그 영을 지으시는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 신탁. 이스라엘에 관한 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀. 하늘을 펴시고 땅의 기초를 놓으시고 사람마다 그 속에 영을 지어 넣으시는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 선언하신다.
ko.R: 이것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘에 관하여 주신 말씀이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 하늘을 펴시고 땅의 기초를 놓으셨다. 그분은 사람마다 그 속에 영을 넣어 주신다. 그분께서 이렇게 말씀하신다.

pt.L: Oráculo: a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} a respeito de Israel. Declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, que estende [os] céus e funda [a] terra e forma o espírito do {{gender:ser humano|homem}} dentro dele:
pt.B: Mensagem: a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} a respeito de Israel. É isto que declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, que estende os céus, lança os alicerces da terra e forma o espírito humano dentro de cada pessoa:
pt.R: Esta é uma mensagem {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} a respeito de Israel. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} estendeu o céu e lançou os alicerces da terra. Ele dá a cada pessoa um espírito dentro dela. É isto que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} diz:

decisions.choice: oracle ... concerning Israel: the heading of the last part of the book (chapters 12-14)
decisions.reason: The heading repeats 9:1 and begins the second of the two oracles that close the book. Chapters 12-14 speak of a final attack of the nations on Jerusalem, the LORD's rescue of the city, the cleansing of his people and his reign over all the earth. The phrase "on that day" comes again and again. The oracle is about Judah and Jerusalem, but it is headed "concerning Israel": Israel is the name of the whole people of God.

decisions.choice: who stretches out the heavens, founds the earth, forms the human spirit: the Creator speaks
decisions.reason: The LORD who speaks is named by what he has made, as in Isaiah 42:5, 44:24 and 51:13, and Psalm 104:2-5. The one who made heaven and earth and gives every human being life can do what this oracle promises. "Spirit" is the breath of life and the inner self (Genesis 2:7; Isaiah 57:16).

decisions.choice: declares the LORD: here at the start of the oracle
decisions.reason: The formula usually comes in the middle or at the end of a saying. Here it stands at the head of the oracle, joined to the titles of the Creator, as in Numbers 24:3-4 and Psalm 110:1, where the same word introduces a solemn saying.

decisions.choice: An oracle (L, B); a message (R); declares the LORD (L, B); This is what he says (R); the spirit of a person within them (L, gender setting)
decisions.reason: The heading follows 9:1. Readable breaks the Creator's titles into short sentences. The Hebrew "humankind" means men and women, so Literal takes the gender setting; Balanced says "the human spirit within each person", which needs none.

decisions.choice: massa "Oracle" (L, B), "Voici un message" (R), as 9:1
decisions.reason: The heading of the book's last part, worded as the first one.

decisions.choice: {{gender:l'être humain|l'homme}} (L) on the noun; "au-dedans de lui" with no span
decisions.reason: French puts the setting on the noun ʾadam; the pronoun that refers back to it is ordinary generic French, where the English needs {{gender:them|him}}.

decisions.choice: "con người ... người" with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span for "a person / man"
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "con người" and "người" are not marked for gender, so there is only one wording.

decisions.choice: ne'um YHWH opening the oracle: "CHÚA phán vậy" (L) / "Đây là lời CHÚA phán" (B)
decisions.reason: At the head of an oracle "phán vậy" would read as a closing formula; B turns it into an introduction, as the English B does.

decisions.choice: "roho ya mwanadamu ndani yake" (L), with no gender span
decisions.reason: "Mwanadamu" and "yake" cover every person, so the English gender setting has no Swahili counterpart.

decisions.choice: "…{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다" (L); "…{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 선언하신다" (B); "그분께서 이렇게 말씀하신다" (R)
decisions.reason: Here "declares the LORD" opens the oracle with the Creator's titles attached (meaning decision), so it is the heading's main verb rather than the closing formula; the prophet speaks of God with -시-. "사람" and "사람마다" need no gender span.

decisions.choice: "Oráculo" (L, B); "Este es un mensaje" (R); "Declara" (L), "Esto afirma" (B), "Esto es lo que él dice" (R)
decisions.reason: The heading of chapters 12-14 is worded as at 9:1. B keeps "afirma", its word for ne'um through the book. Ne'um here opens the oracle, so it stands at the head of the sentence, as the English does.

decisions.choice: ser humano / hombre
decisions.reason: Spanish has both wordings for "adam" here, so L keeps the gender span; "dentro de él" agrees with either.

decisions.choice: Oráculo: a palavra do SENHOR (L); Mensagem: (B); Esta é uma mensagem (R)
decisions.reason: The heading keeps the wording of 9:1 at each level (m1), as the English does (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: o espírito do ser humano / do homem dentro dele (one gender span)
alternatives: do ser humano dentro dele ou dela
decisions.reason: The English Literal has two spans, "a person ... them". Portuguese needs only one, on the noun: "dele" agrees with both "ser humano" and "homem", so the pronoun takes no span (docs/portuguese-style.md, section 7).

source.text: הִנֵּ֣ה אָ֠נֹכִי שָׂ֣ם אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִַ֧ם סַף־רַ֛עַל לְכָל־הָעַמִּ֖ים סָבִ֑יב וְגַ֧ם עַל־יְהוּדָ֛ה יִֽהְיֶ֥ה בַמָּצ֖וֹר עַל־יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, I [am] making Jerusalem a cup of reeling for all the peoples around; and also on Judah it will be in the siege on Jerusalem.

en.L: Look, I am making Jerusalem a cup of reeling for all the peoples around; and Judah also will be in the siege against Jerusalem.
en.B: Look, I am about to make Jerusalem a cup that sends all the surrounding peoples reeling. Judah too will be caught up in the siege against Jerusalem.
en.R: I am going to make Jerusalem like a cup of strong wine that makes all the nations around it stagger like drunk people. When enemies surround Jerusalem and attack it, Judah will be attacked too.

fr.L: Voici, je fais de Jérusalem une coupe d’étourdissement pour tous les peuples d’alentour ; et Juda aussi sera dans le siège contre Jérusalem.
fr.B: Voici que je vais faire de Jérusalem une coupe qui fera chanceler tous les peuples d’alentour. Juda aussi sera pris dans le siège de Jérusalem.
fr.R: Je vais faire de Jérusalem comme une coupe de vin fort qui fera tituber toutes les nations autour d’elle, comme des gens ivres. Quand les ennemis encercleront Jérusalem pour l’attaquer, Juda sera attaqué lui aussi.

es.L: He aquí, yo pongo a Jerusalén como copa de vértigo para todos los pueblos de alrededor; y también Judá estará en el asedio contra Jerusalén.
es.B: Mira, voy a hacer de Jerusalén una copa que hará tambalearse a todos los pueblos de alrededor. También Judá se verá envuelta en el asedio contra Jerusalén.
es.R: Voy a hacer que Jerusalén sea como una copa de vino fuerte que hace tambalearse como borrachos a todas las naciones de alrededor. Cuando los enemigos rodeen y ataquen a Jerusalén, también atacarán a Judá.

vi.L: Kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho Giê-ru-sa-lem thành chén làm choáng váng cho mọi dân tộc chung quanh; và Giu-đa cũng sẽ [ở] trong cuộc vây hãm Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sắp làm cho Giê-ru-sa-lem thành chén rượu làm cho mọi dân tộc chung quanh phải lảo đảo. Giu-đa cũng sẽ bị cuốn vào cuộc vây hãm Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Ta sẽ làm cho Giê-ru-sa-lem như một chén rượu mạnh khiến mọi dân tộc chung quanh phải lảo đảo như người say. Khi kẻ thù bao vây và tấn công Giê-ru-sa-lem, Giu-đa cũng sẽ bị tấn công.

sw.L: Tazama, ninaufanya Yerusalemu kuwa kikombe cha kuyumbisha kwa watu wote wa mataifa wanaouzunguka; na Yuda pia atakuwa katika kuzingirwa kwa Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Tazama, karibu nitaufanya Yerusalemu kuwa kikombe kinachowafanya watu wote wa mataifa wanaouzunguka kuyumbayumba. Yuda naye atanaswa katika kuzingirwa kwa Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Nitaufanya Yerusalemu kuwa kama kikombe cha divai kali kinachowafanya mataifa yote yanayouzunguka kupepesuka kama walevi. Adui watakapouzingira Yerusalemu na kuushambulia, Yuda naye atashambuliwa.

ko.L: 보라, 내가 예루살렘을 사방의 모든 백성들에게 비틀거리게 하는 잔으로 만들겠다. 예루살렘이 포위될 때에 유다도 그러할 것이다.
ko.B: 보아라, 내가 예루살렘을 사방의 모든 백성들을 비틀거리게 하는 잔으로 만들겠다. 예루살렘이 포위될 때에 유다도 그 포위에 휘말릴 것이다.
ko.R: 나는 예루살렘을 독한 포도주가 담긴 잔처럼 만들어서, 그 주변의 모든 민족을 술 취한 사람처럼 비틀거리게 하겠다. 원수들이 예루살렘을 에워싸고 공격할 때, 유다도 공격을 받을 것이다.

pt.L: Eis que faço de Jerusalém um cálice de atordoamento para todos os povos ao redor; e também Judá estará no cerco contra Jerusalém.
pt.B: Vou fazer de Jerusalém um cálice que fará cambalear todos os povos ao redor. Judá também será envolvida no cerco contra Jerusalém.
pt.R: Vou fazer Jerusalém ficar como um cálice de vinho forte, que faz todas as nações ao redor dela cambalearem como bêbados. Quando os inimigos cercarem Jerusalém e a atacarem, Judá também vai ser atacada.

decisions.choice: a cup of reeling: the cup of God's anger that makes the nations stagger
decisions.reason: The prophets picture God's judgment as a cup of strong wine that those who drink it cannot keep from drinking, and that leaves them staggering (Isaiah 51:17, 22; Jeremiah 25:15-28; Psalm 75:9). The nations who come to drink, that is, to take Jerusalem, will be made drunk and helpless by it.

decisions.choice: Judah also will be in the siege: Judah shares Jerusalem's danger
alternatives: Judah will be made to take part in the siege of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is brief: "and also on Judah it will be in the siege on Jerusalem". It is read here as saying that the towns of Judah will also be under attack when Jerusalem is besieged. Some read it as saying that Judah will be forced to join the siege against Jerusalem. Verses 5-7 show Judah and Jerusalem on the same side.

decisions.choice: like a cup of strong wine ... stagger like drunk people; When enemies surround Jerusalem and attack it (R)
decisions.reason: Readable explains the cup (m1) and the siege.

decisions.choice: "copa de vértigo" (L); "una copa que hará tambalearse" (B); "una copa de vino fuerte" (R)
decisions.reason: The cup of reeling is the cup of God's anger; B and R make the picture plain, as the English does.

decisions.choice: um cálice de atordoamento (L); um cálice que fará cambalear (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Cálice" is the word the prophets' cup of judgment has in Portuguese (m1); "cambalear" says what it does to those who drink it.

source.text: וְהָיָ֣ה בַיּוֹם־הַ֠הוּא אָשִׂ֨ים אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם אֶ֤בֶן מַֽעֲמָסָה֙ לְכָל־הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים כָּל־עֹמְסֶ֖יהָ שָׂר֣וֹט יִשָּׂרֵ֑טוּ וְנֶאֶסְפ֣וּ עָלֶ֔יהָ כֹּ֖ל גּוֹיֵ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be on that day [that] I will make Jerusalem a stone of burden for all the peoples; all who lift it will surely injure themselves, and will be gathered against it all [the] nations of the earth.

en.L: And it will be in that day [that] I will set Jerusalem [as] a stone of burden for all the peoples; all who carry it will surely gash themselves; and all the nations of the earth will be gathered against it.
en.B: On that day I will make Jerusalem a heavy stone for all the peoples; everyone who tries to lift it will be badly hurt. And all the nations of the earth will gather against it.
en.R: At that time I will make Jerusalem like a heavy stone for all the nations. Everyone who tries to lift it will be badly hurt. All the nations of the earth will come together to attack it.

fr.L: Et il arrivera en ce jour-là [que] je ferai de Jérusalem une pierre pesante pour tous les peuples ; tous ceux qui la soulèveront se blesseront gravement ; et toutes les nations de la terre se rassembleront contre elle.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, je ferai de Jérusalem une pierre lourde pour tous les peuples ; quiconque voudra la soulever se blessera gravement. Et toutes les nations de la terre se rassembleront contre elle.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, je ferai de Jérusalem comme une pierre lourde pour toutes les nations. Tous ceux qui essaieront de la soulever se blesseront gravement. Toutes les nations de la terre se rassembleront pour l’attaquer.

es.L: Y sucederá en aquel día [que] pondré a Jerusalén [como] piedra pesada para todos los pueblos; todos los que la carguen quedarán gravemente heridos; y se juntarán contra ella todas las naciones de la tierra.
es.B: Aquel día haré de Jerusalén una piedra pesada para todos los pueblos; todo el que intente levantarla saldrá muy malherido. Y todas las naciones de la tierra se reunirán contra ella.
es.R: En ese tiempo haré que Jerusalén sea como una piedra pesada para todas las naciones. Todo el que intente levantarla saldrá muy malherido. Todas las naciones de la tierra se unirán para atacarla.

vi.L: Trong ngày ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho Giê-ru-sa-lem [thành] hòn đá nặng cho mọi dân tộc; mọi kẻ nhấc nó lên chắc chắn sẽ bị thương nặng; và mọi dân tộc trên đất sẽ tụ họp lại chống nghịch nó.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho Giê-ru-sa-lem thành một hòn đá nặng cho mọi dân tộc; ai cố nhấc nó lên sẽ bị thương nặng. Và mọi dân tộc trên đất sẽ tụ họp lại chống nghịch nó.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho Giê-ru-sa-lem như một hòn đá nặng đối với mọi dân tộc. Ai cố nhấc nó lên sẽ bị thương nặng. Mọi dân tộc trên đất sẽ cùng nhau đến tấn công nó.

sw.L: Na itakuwa katika siku ile [kwamba] nitaufanya Yerusalemu [kuwa] jiwe zito kwa watu wote wa mataifa; wote wanaolibeba hakika watajikata vibaya; na mataifa yote ya dunia yatakusanyika dhidi yake.
sw.B: Siku hiyo nitaufanya Yerusalemu kuwa jiwe zito kwa watu wote wa mataifa; kila atakayejaribu kulinyanyua ataumia vibaya. Na mataifa yote ya dunia yatakusanyika dhidi yake.
sw.R: Wakati huo nitaufanya Yerusalemu kuwa kama jiwe zito kwa mataifa yote. Kila atakayejaribu kulinyanyua ataumia vibaya. Mataifa yote ya dunia yatakusanyika ili kuushambulia.

ko.L: 그날에 내가 예루살렘을 모든 백성들에게 무거운 돌로 만들 것이니, 그것을 드는 자는 모두 크게 상처를 입을 것이다. 그리고 땅의 모든 민족들이 그 성을 치려고 모일 것이다.
ko.B: 그날에 나는 예루살렘을 모든 백성들에게 무거운 돌이 되게 하겠다. 그 돌을 들려고 하는 자는 누구나 심하게 다칠 것이다. 땅의 모든 민족들이 예루살렘을 치려고 모여들 것이다.
ko.R: 그때에 나는 예루살렘을 모든 민족에게 무거운 돌처럼 만들겠다. 그 돌을 들려고 하는 사람은 누구나 크게 다칠 것이다. 세상의 모든 민족이 예루살렘을 공격하려고 함께 모일 것이다.

pt.L: E acontecerá naquele dia [que] farei de Jerusalém uma pedra pesada para todos os povos; todos os que a carregarem certamente se ferirão; e todas as nações da terra se ajuntarão contra ela.
pt.B: Naquele dia farei de Jerusalém uma pedra pesada para todos os povos; todos os que tentarem levantá-la ficarão gravemente feridos. E todas as nações da terra se reunirão contra ela.
pt.R: Naquele dia vou fazer Jerusalém ficar como uma pedra pesada para todas as nações. Todos os que tentarem levantá-la vão se machucar muito. Todas as nações da terra vão se juntar para atacá-la.

decisions.choice: a heavy stone: a stone too heavy to lift without injury
decisions.reason: The phrase means "a stone of burden", a stone to be lifted and carried. Jerome, writing in the land of Israel in the fourth century AD, says that young men there tested their strength by lifting heavy round stones. The nations who try to carry Jerusalem off will find it too heavy and will hurt themselves.

decisions.choice: will surely gash themselves: be cut and badly hurt
decisions.reason: The verb means to cut or scratch (Leviticus 21:5), and the doubled form makes it strong. Lifting the stone tears the lifter's own flesh.

decisions.choice: And it will be in that day [that] (L); On that day (B); At that time (R)
decisions.reason: The phrase follows the wording set in Isaiah. Literal keeps the Hebrew "and it will be", as in Joel 4:18.

decisions.choice: "Et il arrivera en ce jour-là" (L), "Ce jour-là" (B), "En ce temps-là" (R), through chapters 12-14
decisions.reason: As the term sheet's "in that day".

decisions.choice: "Y sucederá en aquel día" (L); "Aquel día" (B); "En ese tiempo" (R)
decisions.reason: "In that day" follows the Spanish prophets at each level through chapters 12-14.

decisions.choice: "Trong ngày ấy" / "Vào ngày ấy" / "Vào lúc ấy", through chapters 12–14
decisions.reason: The term sheet's three-level wording for "in that day", kept for every occurrence in these chapters.

decisions.choice: "그날에" (L, B); "그때에" (R)
decisions.reason: The term sheets' wording for "in that day", as in 2:15 and 3:10; recorded once for Zechariah 12-14.

decisions.choice: E acontecerá naquele dia [que] (L); Naquele dia (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Naquele dia" at every level, as set for the whole book at 2:15, where the English Readable says "At that time" (also verses 4, 6, 8, 9, 11 and chapters 13-14); Literal keeps the Hebrew "E acontecerá", as Isaiah 2:2 has it in Portuguese.

source.text: בַּיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא נְאֻם־יְהוָ֗ה אַכֶּ֤ה כָל־סוּס֙ בַּתִּמָּה֔וֹן וְרֹכְב֖וֹ בַּשִּׁגָּע֑וֹן וְעַל־בֵּ֤ית יְהוּדָה֙ אֶפְקַ֣ח אֶת־עֵינַ֔י וְכֹל֙ ס֣וּס הָֽעַמִּ֔ים אַכֶּ֖ה בַּֽעִוָּרֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: On that day, declaration of Yahweh, I will strike every horse with panic and its rider with madness; and on [the] house of Judah I will open my eyes, and every horse of the peoples I will strike with blindness.

en.L: In that day, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, I will strike every horse with bewilderment and its rider with madness; but over the house of Judah I will open {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} eyes, and every horse of the peoples I will strike with blindness.
en.B: On that day, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, I will strike all the horses with terror and their riders with madness. I will keep {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} eyes open over the house of Judah, but I will strike the horses of the peoples with blindness.
en.R: At that time, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, I will make every horse panic and make its rider go mad. I will watch over the people of Judah, but I will make all the horses of the enemy armies blind.

fr.L: En ce jour-là, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je frapperai tout cheval d’égarement et son cavalier de folie ; mais sur la maison de Juda j’ouvrirai {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} yeux, et tout cheval des peuples, je le frapperai d’aveuglement.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je frapperai de panique tous les chevaux, et de folie leurs cavaliers. Je garderai {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} yeux ouverts sur la maison de Juda, mais je frapperai d’aveuglement les chevaux des peuples.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je ferai paniquer tous les chevaux et je rendrai fous leurs cavaliers. Je veillerai sur le peuple de Juda, mais je rendrai aveugles tous les chevaux des armées ennemies.

es.L: En aquel día, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, heriré a todo caballo con pánico y a su jinete con locura; pero sobre la casa de Judá abriré {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ojos, y a todo caballo de los pueblos heriré con ceguera.
es.B: Aquel día, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, heriré de terror a todos los caballos y de locura a sus jinetes. Mantendré {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ojos abiertos sobre la casa de Judá, pero heriré de ceguera a los caballos de los pueblos.
es.R: En ese tiempo, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, haré que todos los caballos se espanten y que sus jinetes se vuelvan locos. Cuidaré del pueblo de Judá, pero dejaré ciegos a todos los caballos de los ejércitos enemigos.

vi.L: Trong ngày ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đánh mọi con ngựa cho hoảng loạn và người cưỡi nó cho điên cuồng; nhưng trên nhà Giu-đa {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ mở mắt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và mọi con ngựa của các dân tộc {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đánh cho đui mù.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho mọi con ngựa kinh hoàng và người cưỡi chúng điên cuồng. Ta sẽ mở mắt canh giữ nhà Giu-đa, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho ngựa của các dân tộc bị mù.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho mọi con ngựa hoảng sợ và người cưỡi nó hóa điên. Ta sẽ trông chừng dân Giu-đa, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho mọi con ngựa của quân thù bị mù.

sw.L: Katika siku ile, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitampiga kila farasi kwa kuchanganyikiwa na mpanda farasi wake kwa wazimu; lakini juu ya nyumba ya Yuda nitayafumbua macho {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, na kila farasi wa mataifa nitampiga kwa upofu.
sw.B: Siku hiyo, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitawapiga farasi wote kwa hofu kuu na wapanda farasi wao kwa wazimu. Nitayaweka macho {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} wazi juu ya nyumba ya Yuda, lakini farasi wa mataifa nitawapiga kwa upofu.
sw.R: Wakati huo, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitamfanya kila farasi aogope sana na mpanda farasi wake awe na wazimu. Nitawaangalia watu wa Yuda, lakini farasi wote wa majeshi ya adui nitawafanya vipofu.

ko.L: 그날에, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다, 내가 모든 말을 놀라게 하고, 그 탄 자를 미치게 하겠다. 그러나 유다 집 위에는 내 눈을 뜨고 있고, 백성들의 모든 말은 눈이 멀게 하겠다.
ko.B: 그날에 나는 모든 말을 겁에 질리게 하고, 말 탄 자들을 미치게 하겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 나는 유다 집을 눈여겨 지켜보겠지만, 백성들의 말들은 모두 눈이 멀게 하겠다.
ko.R: 그때에 나는 모든 말이 겁에 질려 날뛰게 하고, 말 탄 사람들이 미치게 하겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 나는 유다 백성을 지켜 주겠지만, 원수 군대의 말들은 모두 눈이 멀게 하겠다.

pt.L: Naquele dia, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, ferirei todo cavalo com pânico e o seu cavaleiro com loucura; mas sobre a casa de Judá abrirei os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} olhos, e todo cavalo dos povos ferirei com cegueira.
pt.B: Naquele dia, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, ferirei todos os cavalos com terror e os seus cavaleiros com loucura. Manterei os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} olhos abertos sobre a casa de Judá, mas ferirei com cegueira os cavalos dos povos.
pt.R: Naquele dia, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, vou fazer todos os cavalos entrarem em pânico e os seus cavaleiros ficarem loucos. Vou cuidar do povo de Judá, mas vou deixar cegos todos os cavalos dos exércitos inimigos.

decisions.choice: panic, madness, blindness: the curses of Deuteronomy 28:28 turned on the enemy
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 28:28 warns that if Israel breaks the covenant, the LORD will strike them "with madness, with blindness and with confusion of heart". The same three words are used here, but now the LORD turns them on the nations who attack his people.

decisions.choice: I will open my eyes over the house of Judah: I will watch over them with care
decisions.reason: To have one's eyes open toward someone is to watch over them and care for them (1 Kings 8:29; Psalm 32:8). The enemy's horses are blinded, but the LORD's eyes are open over his people.

decisions.choice: In that day, declares the LORD (L); On that day, declares the LORD (B); At that time, says the LORD (R)
decisions.reason: The formulas follow the wording set in Isaiah. Readable says "watch over" for "open my eyes" (m2) and "enemy armies" for "the peoples". The LORD speaks of his own eyes, so "my" takes the deity_pronoun setting.

decisions.choice: "pánico" / "terror", "locura", "ceguera"
decisions.reason: The three curses of Deuteronomy 28:28 are named with the plain Spanish nouns at L and B, so the allusion stays visible.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다" after the first sentence (B, R)
decisions.reason: The formula stands as its own sentence (term sheets); Literal keeps it inside the sentence where the Hebrew has it.

decisions.choice: pânico, loucura, cegueira
decisions.reason: The three curses of Deuteronomy 28:28 (m1) are "loucura", "cegueira" and "pânico", plain Portuguese words a reader can recognise there.

source.text: וְאָֽמְר֛וּ אַלֻּפֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה בְּלִבָּ֑ם אַמְצָ֥ה לִי֙ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם בַּיהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And will say [the] clans of Judah in their heart, Strength to me [are the] inhabitants of Jerusalem in Yahweh of hosts their God.

en.L: And Judah's clans will say in their heart, "The inhabitants of Jerusalem [are] strength to me through {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, their God."
en.B: Then the clans of Judah will say to themselves, "The people of Jerusalem are our strength, through {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, their God."
en.R: Then the family groups of Judah will say to themselves, "The people of Jerusalem give us strength, because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies is their God."

fr.L: Et les clans de Juda diront dans leur cœur : « Les habitants de Jérusalem [sont] ma force par {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, leur Dieu. »
fr.B: Alors les clans de Juda se diront : « Les habitants de Jérusalem sont notre force, grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} des armées, leur Dieu. »
fr.R: Alors les familles de Juda se diront : « Les habitants de Jérusalem nous donnent de la force, parce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées est leur Dieu. »

es.L: Y los clanes de Judá dirán en su corazón: «Mi fuerza [son] los habitantes de Jerusalén, por {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, su Dios».
es.B: Entonces los clanes de Judá dirán para sí: «Los habitantes de Jerusalén son nuestra fuerza, gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, su Dios».
es.R: Entonces los grupos de familias de Judá pensarán: «La gente de Jerusalén nos da fuerzas, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos es su Dios».

vi.L: Các gia tộc Giu-đa sẽ nói trong lòng mình: "Dân cư Giê-ru-sa-lem [là] sức mạnh cho tôi nhờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của họ."
vi.B: Bấy giờ các gia tộc Giu-đa sẽ tự nhủ: "Dân Giê-ru-sa-lem là sức mạnh của chúng ta, nhờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của họ."
vi.R: Bấy giờ các gia tộc Giu-đa sẽ tự nhủ: "Dân Giê-ru-sa-lem giúp chúng ta mạnh mẽ, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân là Đức Chúa Trời của họ."

sw.L: Nazo koo za Yuda zitasema mioyoni mwao, "Wakaaji wa Yerusalemu [ni] nguvu kwangu kupitia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wao."
sw.B: Kisha koo za Yuda zitasema mioyoni mwao, "Watu wa Yerusalemu ni nguvu yetu, kupitia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wao."
sw.R: Kisha jamaa za Yuda zitasemezana, "Watu wa Yerusalemu wanatupa nguvu, kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi ni Mungu wao."

ko.L: 유다의 족장들이 마음속으로 말할 것이다. "예루살렘 주민들이 그들의 하나님 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}로 말미암아 나에게 힘이 된다."
ko.B: 그러면 유다의 족장들이 속으로 말할 것이다. "예루살렘 주민들은 그들의 하나님 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}로 말미암아 우리의 힘이 된다."
ko.R: 그러면 유다의 집안들이 속으로 말할 것이다. "예루살렘 사람들이 우리에게 힘을 준다. 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들의 하나님이시기 때문이다."

pt.L: E os clãs de Judá dirão no seu coração: "Os habitantes de Jerusalém [são] força para mim {{divine_name:no SENHOR|em Javé}} dos Exércitos, o Deus deles."
pt.B: Então os clãs de Judá dirão a si mesmos: "O povo de Jerusalém é a nossa força, por meio {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} dos Exércitos, o Deus deles."
pt.R: Então as famílias de Judá vão pensar: "O povo de Jerusalém nos dá força, porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos é o Deus deles."

decisions.choice: the clans of Judah: Judah's clans and their leaders
decisions.reason: The word is the one used in 9:7, meaning a clan or the chief of a clan. Here it may mean Judah's leaders, who speak for their clans. Either way, the people of the countryside speak.

decisions.choice: the inhabitants of Jerusalem are strength to me through the LORD: Judah takes heart from Jerusalem and its God
alternatives: the inhabitants of Jerusalem have strength in the LORD of hosts their God
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is awkward, and its sense is debated. It is read here as Judah's clans saying that the people of Jerusalem give them strength, because the LORD of hosts is with the city. A small change in the letters gives "there is strength for the inhabitants of Jerusalem in the LORD of hosts their God". Both say that the strength comes from the LORD.

decisions.choice: say in their heart (L); say to themselves (B, R); our strength (B); give us strength (R); the LORD of Armies (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Say in their heart" is the Hebrew way of saying "think". The clans speak as one ("me"); Balanced and Readable say "us".

decisions.choice: "족장들" (L, B); "집안들" (R)
decisions.reason: 'Alluf here means Judah's clans and their leaders (meaning decision); Literal and Balanced name the leaders who speak, Readable the family groups, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "nuestra fuerza" (B); "nos da fuerzas" (R)
decisions.reason: The clans speak as one ("to me") at L; B and R use "we", as the English does.

source.text: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֡וּא אָשִׂים֩ אֶת־אַלֻּפֵ֨י יְהוּדָ֜ה כְּֽכִיּ֧וֹר אֵ֣שׁ בְּעֵצִ֗ים וּכְלַפִּ֥יד אֵשׁ֙ בְּעָמִ֔יר וְאָ֨כְל֜וּ עַל־יָמִ֧ין וְעַל־שְׂמֹ֛אול אֶת־כָּל־הָעַמִּ֖ים סָבִ֑יב וְיָשְׁבָ֨ה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֥ם ע֛וֹד תַּחְתֶּ֖יהָ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: On that day I will make [the] clans of Judah like a pot of fire among wood and like a torch of fire among sheaves, and they will devour on [the] right and on [the] left all the peoples around; and Jerusalem will dwell again in her place, in Jerusalem.

en.L: In that day I will make the clans of Judah like a pot of fire among wood and like a torch of fire among sheaves; and they will devour, on the right and on the left, all the peoples around; and Jerusalem will dwell again in her place, in Jerusalem.
en.B: On that day I will make Judah's clans like a firepot set in a pile of wood, like a flaming torch among sheaves of grain. They will consume all the surrounding peoples on the right and on the left, while Jerusalem stays secure in its place.
en.R: At that time I will make the family groups of Judah like a pot of burning coals in a pile of wood, or like a burning torch among bundles of grain. They will destroy all the nations around them, on every side. But Jerusalem will stay safe where it is.

fr.L: En ce jour-là, je ferai des clans de Juda comme un brasier au milieu du bois, et comme une torche enflammée au milieu des gerbes ; et ils dévoreront, à droite et à gauche, tous les peuples d’alentour ; et Jérusalem habitera encore à sa place, à Jérusalem.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, je ferai des clans de Juda comme un brasero au milieu d’un tas de bois, comme une torche ardente parmi des gerbes. Ils dévoreront à droite et à gauche tous les peuples d’alentour, tandis que Jérusalem restera en sécurité à sa place.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, je rendrai les familles de Juda semblables à un pot plein de braises au milieu d’un tas de bois, ou à une torche allumée parmi des bottes de blé. Elles détruiront toutes les nations autour d’elles, de tous les côtés. Mais Jérusalem restera en sécurité là où elle est.

es.L: En aquel día pondré a los clanes de Judá como brasero de fuego entre la leña y como antorcha de fuego entre gavillas; y devorarán a derecha y a izquierda a todos los pueblos de alrededor; y Jerusalén volverá a habitar en su lugar, en Jerusalén.
es.B: Aquel día haré que los clanes de Judá sean como un brasero puesto entre la leña, como una antorcha encendida entre las gavillas. Consumirán a derecha y a izquierda a todos los pueblos de alrededor, mientras Jerusalén permanece segura en su lugar.
es.R: En ese tiempo haré que los grupos de familias de Judá sean como una olla de brasas en medio de la leña, o como una antorcha encendida entre manojos de trigo. Destruirán a todas las naciones que los rodean, por todos lados. Pero Jerusalén seguirá a salvo donde está.

vi.L: Trong ngày ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho các gia tộc Giu-đa như lò lửa giữa đống củi, như bó đuốc cháy giữa các bó lúa; họ sẽ thiêu nuốt bên phải và bên trái mọi dân tộc chung quanh; và Giê-ru-sa-lem sẽ lại ở yên chỗ của nó, tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho các gia tộc Giu-đa như lò lửa đặt giữa đống củi, như ngọn đuốc cháy giữa các bó lúa. Họ sẽ thiêu nuốt mọi dân tộc chung quanh, bên phải lẫn bên trái, còn Giê-ru-sa-lem vẫn đứng vững tại chỗ của mình.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho các gia tộc Giu-đa như một nồi than hồng giữa đống củi, hay như một ngọn đuốc cháy giữa những bó lúa. Họ sẽ tiêu diệt mọi dân tộc chung quanh, khắp mọi phía. Nhưng Giê-ru-sa-lem sẽ vẫn an toàn tại chỗ của mình.

sw.L: Katika siku ile nitazifanya koo za Yuda kama chungu cha moto katikati ya kuni, na kama mwenge wa moto katikati ya miganda; nazo zitawala, upande wa kuume na upande wa kushoto, watu wote wa mataifa wanaozunguka; na Yerusalemu utakaa tena mahali pake, katika Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Siku hiyo nitazifanya koo za Yuda kama chungu cha moto kilichowekwa katika rundo la kuni, kama mwenge unaowaka katikati ya miganda ya nafaka. Zitawateketeza watu wote wa mataifa wanaozunguka, kuume na kushoto, nao Yerusalemu utabaki salama mahali pake.
sw.R: Wakati huo nitazifanya jamaa za Yuda kama chungu cha makaa ya moto katika rundo la kuni, au kama mwenge unaowaka katikati ya mafungu ya nafaka. Zitayaangamiza mataifa yote yanayozizunguka, pande zote. Lakini Yerusalemu utabaki salama mahali ulipo.

ko.L: 그날에 내가 유다의 족장들을 나무 가운데 있는 불 화로와 곡식단 가운데 있는 불붙은 횃불처럼 만들겠다. 그들이 오른쪽과 왼쪽으로 사방의 모든 백성들을 삼킬 것이다. 그리고 예루살렘은 다시 제자리에, 곧 예루살렘에 머물 것이다.
ko.B: 그날에 나는 유다의 족장들을 장작더미 속의 불 화로처럼, 곡식단 사이의 타오르는 횃불처럼 만들겠다. 그들은 오른쪽과 왼쪽으로 주변의 모든 백성들을 불살라 버릴 것이다. 그동안 예루살렘은 제자리에 안전하게 머물 것이다.
ko.R: 그때에 나는 유다 집안들을 장작더미 속에 놓인 숯불 단지처럼, 곡식 단 사이의 타오르는 횃불처럼 만들겠다. 그들은 사방에 있는 모든 민족을 멸망시킬 것이다. 그러나 예루살렘은 지금 있는 그곳에 안전하게 남아 있을 것이다.

pt.L: Naquele dia farei os clãs de Judá como um braseiro no meio da lenha e como uma tocha de fogo no meio dos feixes; e devorarão, à direita e à esquerda, todos os povos ao redor; e Jerusalém habitará de novo no seu lugar, em Jerusalém.
pt.B: Naquele dia farei os clãs de Judá como um braseiro posto num monte de lenha, como uma tocha acesa no meio de feixes de trigo. Eles consumirão todos os povos ao redor, à direita e à esquerda, enquanto Jerusalém permanecerá segura no seu lugar.
pt.R: Naquele dia vou fazer as famílias de Judá ficarem como uma panela de brasas num monte de lenha, ou como uma tocha acesa no meio de feixes de trigo. Elas vão destruir todas as nações ao seu redor, de todos os lados. Mas Jerusalém vai continuar segura onde está.

decisions.choice: a pot of fire among wood, a torch among sheaves: Judah will set the enemy ablaze
decisions.reason: A pot of live coals was used to carry fire; set down in a woodpile, it sets the whole pile alight. A torch among cut grain does the same (Judges 15:4-5). The small clans of Judah will consume the nations around them.

decisions.choice: on the right and on the left: on every side
decisions.reason: The phrase means in every direction (Isaiah 9:19; 54:3).

decisions.choice: Jerusalem will dwell again in her place, in Jerusalem: the city will stay where it is, unmoved
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names Jerusalem twice: the people of Jerusalem (the first time) will live on in their city (the second time). The city that the nations meant to carry off stays on its own site (14:10).

decisions.choice: firepot (B); a pot of burning coals (R); stays secure in its place (B); will stay safe where it is (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the "pot of fire" was (m1), and say "in its place" once, without the second "in Jerusalem" (m3).

decisions.choice: "brasero" (L, B); "olla de brasas" (R)
decisions.reason: The pot of fire is a pan of live coals; Spanish "brasero" names it, and R describes it.

decisions.choice: "koo" (clans) of Judah (L, B); "jamaa" (R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet's "koo za Yuda" (Micah 5:1); Readable uses the everyday "jamaa" (family groups), as the English Readable.

decisions.choice: um braseiro (L, B); uma panela de brasas (R); uma tocha
decisions.reason: "Braseiro" is the Portuguese word for a pot of live coals (m1); Readable describes it.

source.text: וְהוֹשִׁ֧יעַ יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־אָהֳלֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה בָּרִֽאשֹׁנָ֑ה לְמַ֨עַן לֹֽא־תִגְדַּ֜ל תִּפְאֶ֣רֶת בֵּית־דָּוִ֗יד וְתִפְאֶ֛רֶת יֹשֵׁ֥ב יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם עַל־יְהוּדָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And Yahweh will save the tents of Judah at first, so that will not be great [the] glory of [the] house of David and [the] glory of [the] inhabitant of Jerusalem over Judah.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will save the tents of Judah at first, so that the splendor of the house of David and the splendor of the inhabitants of Jerusalem may not grow great over Judah.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will rescue the tents of Judah first, so that the honor of the house of David and of the people of Jerusalem will not be raised above Judah.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will rescue the people of the towns and villages of Judah first. Then the royal family of David and the people of Jerusalem will not think they are more important than the rest of Judah.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sauvera d’abord les tentes de Juda, afin que la gloire de la maison de David et la gloire des habitants de Jérusalem ne s’élève pas au-dessus de Juda.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} délivrera d’abord les tentes de Juda, pour que l’honneur de la maison de David et des habitants de Jérusalem ne soit pas élevé au-dessus de Juda.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} délivrera d’abord les gens des villes et des villages de Juda. Ainsi, la famille royale de David et les habitants de Jérusalem ne se croiront pas plus importants que le reste de Juda.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} salvará primero las tiendas de Judá, para que la gloria de la casa de David y la gloria de los habitantes de Jerusalén no se engrandezca sobre Judá.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} librará primero las tiendas de Judá, para que el honor de la casa de David y de los habitantes de Jerusalén no se eleve por encima de Judá.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} rescatará primero a la gente de los pueblos y aldeas de Judá. Así la familia real de David y la gente de Jerusalén no se creerán más importantes que el resto de Judá.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ giải cứu các trại của Giu-đa trước tiên, để vinh hiển của nhà Đa-vít và vinh hiển của dân cư Giê-ru-sa-lem không vượt trên Giu-đa.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ giải cứu các trại của Giu-đa trước, để vinh dự của nhà Đa-vít và của dân Giê-ru-sa-lem không được đề cao hơn Giu-đa.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ giải cứu dân cư các thành và làng của Giu-đa trước. Như vậy hoàng tộc Đa-vít và dân Giê-ru-sa-lem sẽ không nghĩ rằng mình quan trọng hơn phần còn lại của Giu-đa.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataziokoa hema za Yuda kwanza, ili utukufu wa nyumba ya Daudi na utukufu wa wakaaji wa Yerusalemu usiwe mkuu kuliko Yuda.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataziokoa hema za Yuda kwanza, ili heshima ya nyumba ya Daudi na ya watu wa Yerusalemu isiinuliwe juu ya Yuda.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawaokoa kwanza watu wa miji na vijiji vya Yuda. Ndipo jamaa ya kifalme ya Daudi na watu wa Yerusalemu hawatajiona kuwa bora kuliko Yuda wengine.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 유다의 장막들을 먼저 구원하실 것이니, 다윗 집의 영광과 예루살렘 주민들의 영광이 유다보다 커지지 않게 하려는 것이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 유다의 장막들을 먼저 구해 내실 것이다. 다윗 집의 영광과 예루살렘 주민들의 영광이 유다보다 높아지지 않게 하시려는 것이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 유다의 마을들에 사는 사람들을 먼저 구해 내실 것이다. 그러면 다윗 왕의 집안과 예루살렘 사람들이 나머지 유다 사람들보다 자기들이 더 중요하다고 생각하지 않을 것이다.

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} salvará primeiro as tendas de Judá, para que o esplendor da casa de Davi e o esplendor dos habitantes de Jerusalém não se engrandeçam sobre Judá.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} livrará primeiro as tendas de Judá, para que a honra da casa de Davi e a do povo de Jerusalém não sejam exaltadas acima de Judá.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} vai livrar primeiro o povo das cidades e aldeias de Judá. Assim, a família real de Davi e o povo de Jerusalém não vão pensar que são mais importantes do que o resto de Judá.

decisions.choice: the tents of Judah: the people of the countryside
decisions.reason: "Tents" is an old word for homes (1 Kings 8:66; Jeremiah 30:18). Here it means the open towns and villages of Judah, which had no walls to protect them, in contrast to the walled city of Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: so that the glory of the house of David ... may not be made great over Judah: no pride of the capital over the rest
decisions.reason: The LORD saves the weakest first, so that the royal family and the capital cannot boast over the countryside. The victory is the LORD's, shared by all his people (1 Corinthians 1:27-29 gives the same reason for God's choices).

decisions.choice: the people of the towns and villages of Judah; the royal family of David; think they are more important (R)
decisions.reason: Readable explains "the tents of Judah" (m1) and what "glory over Judah" means (m2).

source.text: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יָגֵ֤ן יְהוָה֙ בְּעַד֙ יוֹשֵׁ֣ב יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְהָיָ֞ה הַנִּכְשָׁ֥ל בָּהֶ֛ם בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא כְּדָוִ֑יד וּבֵ֤ית דָּוִיד֙ כֵּֽאלֹהִ֔ים כְּמַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהוָ֖ה לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: On that day Yahweh will defend the inhabitant of Jerusalem, and will be the one stumbling among them on that day like David, and the house of David like God, like [the] angel of Yahweh before them.

en.L: In that day {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the one who stumbles among them in that day will be like David; and the house of David like God, like the angel of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} before them.
en.B: On that day {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will shield the people of Jerusalem. On that day even the feeblest of them will be like David, and David's house like God, like the angel of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} at their head.
en.R: At that time {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will protect the people of Jerusalem. Even the weakest of them will be as strong as King David. David's family will be like God, like the angel of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} who leads them.

fr.L: En ce jour-là, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} protégera les habitants de Jérusalem, et celui qui chancelle parmi eux sera en ce jour-là comme David ; et la maison de David [sera] comme Dieu, comme l’ange {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} devant eux.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sera le bouclier des habitants de Jérusalem. Ce jour-là, le plus faible d’entre eux sera comme David, et la maison de David comme Dieu, comme l’ange {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} qui marche à leur tête.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} protégera les habitants de Jérusalem. Même le plus faible d’entre eux sera aussi fort que le roi David. La famille de David sera comme Dieu, comme l’ange {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} qui les conduit.

es.L: En aquel día {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} defenderá a los habitantes de Jerusalén, y el que tropiece entre ellos en aquel día será como David; y la casa de David, como Dios, como el ángel {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} delante de ellos.
es.B: Aquel día {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} protegerá como un escudo a los habitantes de Jerusalén. Aquel día aun el más débil de ellos será como David, y la casa de David será como Dios, como el ángel {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que va al frente de ellos.
es.R: En ese tiempo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} protegerá a la gente de Jerusalén. Aun el más débil de ellos será tan fuerte como el rey David. La familia de David será como Dios, como el ángel {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que los guía.

vi.L: Trong ngày ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ che chở dân cư Giê-ru-sa-lem; và trong ngày ấy, kẻ yếu đuối nhất trong họ sẽ như Đa-vít, và nhà Đa-vít sẽ như Đức Chúa Trời, như thiên sứ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đi trước họ.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ che chở dân Giê-ru-sa-lem. Vào ngày ấy, ngay cả người yếu ớt nhất trong họ cũng sẽ như Đa-vít, và nhà Đa-vít sẽ như Đức Chúa Trời, như thiên sứ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} dẫn đầu họ.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ bảo vệ dân Giê-ru-sa-lem. Ngay cả người yếu nhất trong họ cũng sẽ mạnh mẽ như vua Đa-vít. Gia đình Đa-vít sẽ như Đức Chúa Trời, như thiên sứ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} dẫn dắt họ.

sw.L: Katika siku ile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawalinda wakaaji wa Yerusalemu, na yule anayejikwaa kati yao katika siku ile atakuwa kama Daudi; na nyumba ya Daudi [itakuwa] kama Mungu, kama malaika wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mbele yao.
sw.B: Siku hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawakinga watu wa Yerusalemu. Siku hiyo hata aliye dhaifu kuliko wote kati yao atakuwa kama Daudi, na nyumba ya Daudi itakuwa kama Mungu, kama malaika wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anayewatangulia.
sw.R: Wakati huo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawalinda watu wa Yerusalemu. Hata aliye dhaifu kuliko wote kati yao atakuwa na nguvu kama mfalme Daudi. Jamaa ya Daudi itakuwa kama Mungu, kama malaika wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anayewaongoza.

ko.L: 그날에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 예루살렘 주민들을 보호하실 것이니, 그들 가운데 비틀거리는 자도 그날에는 다윗 같고, 다윗 집은 하나님 같고, 그들 앞에 [가는] {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 천사 같을 것이다.
ko.B: 그날에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 예루살렘 사람들을 방패처럼 지켜 주실 것이다. 그날에는 그들 가운데 가장 약한 사람도 다윗처럼 되고, 다윗의 집은 하나님처럼, 그들 앞에서 이끄는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 천사처럼 될 것이다.
ko.R: 그때에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 예루살렘 사람들을 지켜 주실 것이다. 그들 가운데 가장 약한 사람도 다윗 왕처럼 강해질 것이다. 다윗의 집안은 하나님처럼, 그들을 이끄는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 천사처럼 될 것이다.

pt.L: Naquele dia {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} defenderá os habitantes de Jerusalém, e o que tropeça entre eles naquele dia será como Davi; e a casa de Davi, como Deus, como o anjo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} diante deles.
pt.B: Naquele dia {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} protegerá como um escudo o povo de Jerusalém. Naquele dia, até o mais fraco entre eles será como Davi, e a casa de Davi será como Deus, como o anjo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} à frente deles.
pt.R: Naquele dia {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} vai proteger o povo de Jerusalém. Até o mais fraco deles vai ser tão forte como o rei Davi. A família de Davi vai ser como Deus, como o anjo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} que vai à frente deles.

decisions.choice: the one who stumbles will be like David: the weakest will be as strong as the warrior king
decisions.reason: "The one who stumbles" is the weak and feeble (1 Samuel 2:4). David was remembered as the great warrior who killed Goliath and won Israel's wars. On that day even the weakest will fight like him.

decisions.choice: the house of David will be like God, like the angel of the LORD: like a divine leader going ahead of the people
decisions.reason: The word for God can also mean a divine or heavenly being, and the next words limit it: "like the angel of the LORD before them". The angel of the LORD went before Israel out of Egypt (Exodus 14:19; 23:20; 32:34). The royal house will lead the people with God's own strength. People said of David himself that he was "like the angel of God" in wisdom (2 Samuel 14:17, 20; 19:28).

decisions.choice: defend: shield
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used in 9:15, from the word for a shield.

decisions.choice: In that day ... in that day (L); On that day ... On that day (B); At that time (R, once)
decisions.reason: The formula follows the wording set in Isaiah. Readable says it once, since the second only repeats the first, and says "as strong as King David" to make the comparison clear (m1).

decisions.choice: "l'ange du SEIGNEUR" with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: As the term sheet and Genesis 16:7.

decisions.choice: "el ángel del SEÑOR"
decisions.reason: The angel of the LORD takes no deity_pronoun span, as the term sheet sets.

decisions.choice: "thiên sứ của CHÚA", with no deity span
decisions.reason: The term sheet's form, as Judges 6:22.

decisions.choice: "malaika wa BWANA", with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: As the term sheet and Genesis 16:7.

source.text: וְהָיָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא אֲבַקֵּ֗שׁ לְהַשְׁמִיד֙ אֶת־כָּל־הַגּוֹיִ֔ם הַבָּאִ֖ים עַל־יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be on that day [that] I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.

en.L: And it will be in that day [that] I will seek to wipe out all the nations that are coming against Jerusalem.
en.B: On that day I will set about destroying every nation that comes against Jerusalem.
en.R: At that time I will make sure that all the nations that attack Jerusalem are destroyed.

fr.L: Et il arrivera en ce jour-là [que] je chercherai à exterminer toutes les nations qui viennent contre Jérusalem.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, je {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appliquerai à détruire toutes les nations qui viendront contre Jérusalem.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, je ferai en sorte que toutes les nations qui attaquent Jérusalem soient détruites.

es.L: Y sucederá en aquel día [que] procuraré destruir a todas las naciones que vengan contra Jerusalén.
es.B: Aquel día me pondré a destruir a todas las naciones que vengan contra Jerusalén.
es.R: En ese tiempo me aseguraré de que sean destruidas todas las naciones que ataquen a Jerusalén.

vi.L: Trong ngày ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ tìm cách tiêu diệt mọi dân tộc đến tấn công Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ra tay tiêu diệt mọi dân tộc đến tấn công Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ tiêu diệt cho bằng được mọi dân tộc tấn công Giê-ru-sa-lem.

sw.L: Na itakuwa katika siku ile [kwamba] nitatafuta kuyaangamiza mataifa yote yanayokuja dhidi ya Yerusalemu.

records.literal_gloss: And I will pour out on [the] house of David and on [the] inhabitant of Jerusalem a spirit of grace and supplications, and they will look to me, [the one] whom they have pierced; and they will mourn over him like [the] mourning over the only [child], and [there will be] bitterness over him like [the] bitterness over the firstborn.

en.L: And I will pour out upon the house of David and on the inhabitants of Jerusalem a spirit of grace and of pleas for mercy, and they will look on {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, the one they pierced; and they will mourn for him as one mourns for an only [son], and grieve bitterly for him as one grieves bitterly for a firstborn.
en.B: On the house of David and on the people of Jerusalem I will pour out a spirit of grace and of prayer for mercy. They will look on {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, the one they pierced, and they will mourn for him as one mourns for an only son, and weep bitterly over him as for a firstborn son.
en.R: I will pour out on the family of David and the people of Jerusalem a spirit of kindness and of praying for mercy. They will look on {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, the one they pierced. They will mourn for him as parents mourn for their only son. They will cry bitterly over him as people cry over the death of their oldest son.

es.L: Y derramaré sobre la casa de David y sobre los habitantes de Jerusalén un espíritu de gracia y de súplicas, y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} mirarán a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, a quien traspasaron; y harán duelo por él como se hace duelo por un [hijo] único, y llorarán amargamente por él como se llora por el primogénito.

es.R: Derramaré sobre la familia de David y sobre la gente de Jerusalén un espíritu de bondad y de oración para pedir misericordia. Me mirarán a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, al que atravesaron. Harán duelo por él como los padres lloran por su único hijo. Llorarán amargamente por él como se llora la muerte del hijo mayor.

vi.L: Ta sẽ đổ trên nhà Đa-vít và trên dân cư Giê-ru-sa-lem một tâm linh của ân điển và của sự nài xin, và họ sẽ nhìn lên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, là Đấng họ đã đâm; họ sẽ khóc thương người như người ta khóc thương con [trai] một, và than khóc đắng cay vì người như người ta than khóc đắng cay vì con đầu lòng.
vi.B: Ta sẽ đổ trên nhà Đa-vít và dân Giê-ru-sa-lem một tâm linh của ân điển và của sự cầu xin thương xót. Họ sẽ nhìn lên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, là Đấng họ đã đâm, và họ sẽ khóc thương người như khóc thương con trai một, sẽ than khóc đắng cay vì người như than khóc con trai đầu lòng.

Họ sẽ khóc thương người như cha mẹ khóc thương đứa con trai duy nhất. Họ sẽ khóc lóc đắng cay vì người như người ta khóc khi con trai đầu lòng qua đời.

sw.L: Nami nitamimina juu ya nyumba ya Daudi na juu ya wakaaji wa Yerusalemu roho ya neema na ya kusihi, nao watanitazama {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, yule waliyemtoboa; nao watamwombolezea kama mtu amwombolezeavyo [mwana] wa pekee, na kumlilia kwa uchungu kama mtu amliliavyo kwa uchungu mzaliwa wa kwanza.
sw.B: Juu ya nyumba ya Daudi na juu ya watu wa Yerusalemu nitamimina roho ya neema na ya kuomba rehema. Watanitazama {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, yule waliyemtoboa, nao watamwombolezea kama mtu amwombolezeavyo mwana wa pekee, na kumlilia kwa uchungu kama kwa mwana mzaliwa wa kwanza.
sw.R: Nitamimina juu ya jamaa ya Daudi na watu wa Yerusalemu roho ya wema na ya kuomba rehema. Watanitazama {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, yule waliyemtoboa. Watamwombolezea kama wazazi wanavyomwombolezea mwana wao wa pekee. Watamlilia kwa uchungu kama watu wanavyolia kifo cha mwana wao wa kwanza.

ko.L: 내가 다윗 집과 예루살렘 주민들 위에 은혜와 간구의 영을 부어 주겠다. 그러면 그들이 자기들이 찌른 나를 바라볼 것이다. 그리고 그들은 외아들을 위하여 애곡하듯 그를 위하여 애곡하고, 맏아들을 위하여 슬피 울듯 그를 위하여 슬피 울 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 다윗 집과 예루살렘 주민들 위에 은혜와 간구의 영을 부어 주겠다. 그러면 그들이 자기들이 찌른 나를 바라볼 것이다. 그들은 외아들을 잃고 애곡하듯 그를 위하여 애곡하고, 맏아들을 잃고 통곡하듯 그를 위하여 통곡할 것이다.
ko.R: 나는 다윗의 집안과 예루살렘 사람들에게 은혜의 영을 부어 주어, 그들이 나에게 자비를 구하며 기도하게 하겠다. 그러면 그들이 자기들이 찌른 나를 바라볼 것이다. 그들은 외아들을 잃은 부모처럼 그를 위하여 슬퍼할 것이다. 맏아들이 죽었을 때처럼 그를 위하여 몹시 울 것이다.

pt.L: E derramarei sobre a casa de Davi e sobre os habitantes de Jerusalém um espírito de graça e de súplicas, e olharão para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, a quem traspassaram; e o prantearão como se pranteia por um [filho] único, e chorarão amargamente por ele como se chora amargamente por um primogênito.
pt.B: Sobre a casa de Davi e sobre o povo de Jerusalém derramarei um espírito de graça e de súplica. Olharão para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, a quem traspassaram, e o prantearão como se pranteia um filho único, e chorarão amargamente por ele como por um filho primogênito.
pt.R: Vou derramar sobre a família de Davi e sobre o povo de Jerusalém um espírito de bondade e de oração pedindo misericórdia. Olharão para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, a quem traspassaram. Vão chorar por ele como os pais choram por um filho único. Vão chorar amargamente por ele como se chora a morte do filho mais velho.

decisions.choice: a spirit of grace and of pleas for mercy: God's gift that moves the people to seek his mercy
decisions.reason: To "pour out" a spirit is God's own gift of a new heart and will (Joel 3:1; Ezekiel 39:29). "Grace" is God's favor, and the second word means pleading for mercy. The spirit God gives turns the people to him in sorrow and prayer.

decisions.choice: they will look on me: the Hebrew text, against the reading "on him"
alternatives: they will look on him, the one they pierced
decisions.reason: The standard Hebrew text, with most manuscripts, has "on me", and the Septuagint agrees. A number of medieval Hebrew manuscripts read "on him", which makes the sentence run more smoothly into "they will mourn for him". The harder reading "on me" is very likely the original, since scribes would change it to "on him" and not the other way round. It is kept here. John 19:37 quotes the verse as "they will look on the one they pierced", without either pronoun.

decisions.choice: me, the one they pierced ... him: who is pierced
alternatives: they will look to me concerning the one they pierced (a person distinct from God)
decisions.reason: The LORD speaks, and says "they will look on me"; the next words, "the one they pierced", may describe the LORD himself, and the verse then goes on to speak of "him". Three main readings are given. First, the LORD so binds himself to the one pierced that to pierce him was to strike at the LORD. Second, the words may mean "they will look to me concerning the one they pierced", so that the pierced one is a person distinct from God: some Jewish readers have seen a leader of the people killed in battle, and the Talmud speaks of a messiah son of Joseph who will be slain. Third, the New Testament reads the verse of Jesus, pierced on the cross (m6). The Hebrew allows the first two; the text does not say who the pierced one is.

decisions.choice: pierced: thrust through, killed
decisions.reason: The verb means to run someone through with a sword or spear, usually to death (Numbers 25:8; 1 Samuel 31:4). In 13:3 it is used of parents running through a son who prophesies falsely. The Septuagint read a similar verb meaning "mocked" or "danced in triumph".

decisions.choice: mourn as for an only son, as for a firstborn: the deepest grief
decisions.reason: The loss of an only son, or of the firstborn, was the bitterest grief there was, because it ended a family's future (Amos 8:10; Jeremiah 6:26). The mourning is for the one pierced, and it goes with repentance: the people grieve for what they have done.

decisions.choice: quoted in John 19:37, and taken up in Revelation 1:7
decisions.reason: John 19:37 quotes this verse when a soldier pierces the side of Jesus on the cross: "They will look on the one they pierced". Revelation 1:7 joins it to Daniel 7:13 of Jesus' coming: every eye will see him, "even those who pierced him", and all the tribes of the earth will mourn (compare verses 12-14 here).

decisions.choice: on me (deity_pronoun setting); him (no setting)
decisions.reason: "Me" is the LORD speaking of himself, so it takes the deity_pronoun setting, as every pronoun the LORD uses of himself does. "Him", the one mourned, takes none. The verse moves to the third person, and whether "him" is the LORD, a human figure, or Jesus as the New Testament reads it, is the question the decisions leave open (m3). As with the king of 9:9, a capital letter would settle it.

decisions.choice: they will look on me, the one they pierced (every level); as for an only son
decisions.reason: The words "they will look on me, the one they pierced" are the same at every level, as set for this verse, so that the reader can follow the quotation in John 19:37. The comparison with mourning for an only son follows Amos 8:10.

decisions.choice: "ils regarderont vers moi, celui qu'ils ont transpercé" at every level
alternatives: "ils regarderont vers moi qu'ils ont transpercé"
decisions.reason: The published John 19:37 has "Ils regarderont vers celui qu'ils ont transpercé"; French keeps those words and adds the Hebrew "moi", as the term sheet asks; "lui" for the one mourned takes no span, as in English.

decisions.choice: "me mirarán a mí, a quien / al que traspasaron" (L, B); "atravesaron" (R)
decisions.reason: The words follow John 19:37 in Spanish ("traspasaron" at L and B, "atravesaron" at R) so the quotation can be seen; the Hebrew "on me" takes deity_pronoun spans, as in the English, while "him" takes none.

decisions.choice: "họ sẽ nhìn lên Ta, là Đấng họ đã đâm", then "khóc thương người", lowercase
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording, shared with John 19:37 ("Họ sẽ nhìn lên Đấng họ đã đâm") so the quotation is visible; "người" keeps the Hebrew's shift from "me" to "him" without settling who is meant.

decisions.choice: ruach here "một tâm linh", lowercase
decisions.reason: The English keeps "spirit" lowercase: a disposition God gives; "tâm linh" is the word of Psalm 51:12 and Ezekiel's "tâm linh mới".

decisions.choice: "watanitazama mimi, yule waliyemtoboa", with the span on the free "mimi" only
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text has "on me", as the English and its footnoted text_variant decision. The verb "kutoboa" is the published John 19:37 ("Watamtazama yule waliyemtoboa"), which follows the reading "on him".

decisions.choice: "roho ya neema" lowercase, with class 9 agreement
decisions.reason: The English keeps "spirit" lowercase here: a disposition God gives, not a title for the Spirit, so Swahili writes "roho ya".

decisions.choice: "자기들이 찌른 나를 바라볼 것이다" at every level
decisions.reason: As the term sheet; John 19:37 quotes the verse as "자기들이 찌른 그를 바라볼 것이다" from the Greek, so the shared words are kept and only "나를" (the Hebrew text, meaning decision) differs. God speaks without -시-, and "그" for the one mourned has no honorific, as the English has no deity span on "him".

decisions.choice: olharão para mim, a quem traspassaram (every level)
decisions.reason: The words keep one wording at every level, as the English does (r-en-2), so that the reader can follow the quotation: "traspassar" is the verb John 19:37 and Revelation 1:7 use in Portuguese (m4, m6). The Hebrew has "para mim" (m2), so Portuguese follows it here, where John's Portuguese has "para aquele" from the Greek. "Mim" is the LORD speaking of himself and takes the deity_pronoun span; "o", "ele", the one mourned, take none (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: um espírito de graça e de súplicas (L, B); de bondade e de oração pedindo misericórdia (R)
alternatives: um espírito de favor e de rogos
decisions.reason: "Graça" and "súplica" (m1) are the Portuguese words for God's favour and pleading for mercy; Readable spells them out, as the English Readable does.

source.text: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִגְדַּ֤ל הַמִּסְפֵּד֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם כְּמִסְפַּ֥ד הֲדַדְ־רִמּ֖וֹן בְּבִקְעַ֥ת מְגִדּֽוֹן׃

vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, dân Giê-ru-sa-lem sẽ khóc than đắng cay như người ta đã khóc than tại Ha-đát-Rim-môn trong thung lũng Mê-ghi-đô.

ko.L: 그날에 예루살렘에 큰 애곡이 있을 것인데, 므깃도 평야에 있는 하다드림몬의 애곡과 같을 것이다.
ko.B: 그날에 예루살렘의 애곡은 므깃도 평야의 하다드림몬에서 있었던 애곡만큼 클 것이다.
ko.R: 그때에 예루살렘 사람들은 전에 사람들이 므깃도 골짜기의 하다드림몬에서 슬피 울었던 것처럼 몹시 슬퍼할 것이다.

pt.L: Naquele dia o pranto em Jerusalém será grande, como o pranto de Hadade-Rimom na planície de Megido.
pt.B: Naquele dia o pranto em Jerusalém será tão grande como o pranto em Hadade-Rimom, na planície de Megido.
pt.R: Naquele dia o povo de Jerusalém vai chorar tão amargamente como o povo chorou em Hadade-Rimom, no vale de Megido.

decisions.choice: the mourning of Hadad-rimmon in the plain of Megiddo: probably the mourning for King Josiah
alternatives: the ritual mourning for the god Hadad-rimmon
decisions.reason: Hadad-rimmon is named only here. It is most often taken as a place near Megiddo, and the mourning as the great lament for King Josiah, who was killed in battle with Pharaoh Neco in the plain of Megiddo in 609 BC (2 Kings 23:29; 2 Chronicles 35:22-25). His death was mourned for generations. Others take Hadad-rimmon as the name of a storm god, Hadad, also called Rimmon (2 Kings 5:18), whose worshipers mourned him each year as dead, as women wept for Tammuz (Ezekiel 8:14). Either way, the comparison is with a mourning remembered as the greatest the people knew.

decisions.choice: the mourning at Hadad-rimmon (B, R); valley of Megiddo (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable read Hadad-rimmon as a place (m1); Literal keeps "of", which allows either reading. Readable says "valley" as 2 Chronicles 35:22 does.

decisions.choice: "Hadad-Rimmôn", "la plaine de Meguiddo" (L, B), "la vallée de Meguiddo" (R)
decisions.reason: The names as the term sheet.

decisions.choice: "Hadad-rimón", "Meguido"
decisions.reason: Meguido is the published form (1 Kings 4:12); Hadad-rimón follows the term sheet.

decisions.choice: "Hadad-rimoni", "Megido"
decisions.reason: "Megido" is the published Swahili form (2 Kings 23:29); "Hadad-rimoni" is new, formed by the usual pattern.

decisions.choice: Hadade-Rimom; Megido; a planície (L, B), o vale (R)
decisions.reason: The place (m1) is written as Portuguese writes its sounds, "Hadade-Rimom", with the vowel Portuguese adds and the final "m" of "Rimom"; "Megido" as 2 Chronicles 35:22 has it in Portuguese, where Readable takes "vale" from.

source.text: וְסָפְדָ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ מִשְׁפָּח֥וֹת מִשְׁפָּח֖וֹת לְבָ֑ד מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת בֵּית־דָּוִ֤יד לְבָד֙ וּנְשֵׁיהֶ֣ם לְבָ֔ד מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת בֵּית־נָתָן֙ לְבָ֔ד וּנְשֵׁיהֶ֖ם לְבָֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And will mourn the land, clans [by] clans, alone; [the] clan of [the] house of David alone, and their wives alone; [the] clan of [the] house of Nathan alone, and their wives alone;

en.L: And the land will mourn, clan by clan, each by itself: the clan of the house of David by itself, and their wives by themselves; the clan of the house of Nathan by itself, and their wives by themselves;
en.B: The whole land will mourn, each clan on its own: the clan of David's house on its own, and their wives on their own; the clan of Nathan's house on its own, and their wives on their own;
en.R: Everyone in the land will mourn, each family group by itself. The family of David will mourn by themselves, and their wives by themselves. The family of Nathan will mourn by themselves, and their wives by themselves.

fr.L: Et le pays se lamentera, clan par clan, chacun à part : le clan de la maison de David à part, et leurs femmes à part ; le clan de la maison de Nathan à part, et leurs femmes à part ;
fr.B: Tout le pays sera dans le deuil, chaque clan séparément : le clan de la maison de David séparément, et leurs femmes séparément ; le clan de la maison de Nathan séparément, et leurs femmes séparément ;
fr.R: Tout le monde dans le pays pleurera, chaque famille de son côté. La famille de David pleurera de son côté, et les femmes de cette famille de leur côté. La famille de Nathan pleurera de son côté, et les femmes de cette famille de leur côté.

es.L: Y la tierra hará duelo, clan por clan, cada uno aparte: el clan de la casa de David aparte, y sus mujeres aparte; el clan de la casa de Natán aparte, y sus mujeres aparte;
es.B: Toda la tierra hará duelo, cada clan por su lado: el clan de la casa de David por su lado, y sus mujeres por su lado; el clan de la casa de Natán por su lado, y sus mujeres por su lado;
es.R: Todos en el país harán duelo, cada grupo de familias por separado. La familia de David hará duelo por separado, y sus mujeres por separado. La familia de Natán hará duelo por separado, y sus mujeres por separado.

vi.L: Cả xứ sẽ khóc than, từng gia tộc một, riêng biệt: gia tộc nhà Đa-vít riêng, và vợ họ riêng; gia tộc nhà Na-than riêng, và vợ họ riêng;
vi.B: Cả xứ sẽ khóc than, mỗi gia tộc một nơi: gia tộc nhà Đa-vít một nơi, và vợ họ một nơi; gia tộc nhà Na-than một nơi, và vợ họ một nơi;
vi.R: Mọi người trong xứ sẽ khóc than, mỗi gia tộc khóc riêng. Gia đình Đa-vít sẽ khóc riêng, và vợ họ khóc riêng. Gia đình Na-than sẽ khóc riêng, và vợ họ khóc riêng.

sw.L: Na nchi itaomboleza, ukoo kwa ukoo, kila mmoja peke yake: ukoo wa nyumba ya Daudi peke yao, na wake zao peke yao; ukoo wa nyumba ya Nathani peke yao, na wake zao peke yao;
sw.B: Nchi yote itaomboleza, kila ukoo peke yake: ukoo wa nyumba ya Daudi peke yao, na wake zao peke yao; ukoo wa nyumba ya Nathani peke yao, na wake zao peke yao;
sw.R: Kila mtu katika nchi ataomboleza, kila jamaa peke yake. Jamaa ya Daudi wataomboleza peke yao, na wake zao peke yao. Jamaa ya Nathani wataomboleza peke yao, na wake zao peke yao.

ko.L: 그 땅이 족속마다 따로 애곡할 것이다. 다윗 집 족속이 따로, 그들의 아내들이 따로, 나단 집 족속이 따로, 그들의 아내들이 따로,
ko.B: 온 땅이 족속마다 따로 애곡할 것이다. 다윗 집 족속이 따로 애곡하고, 그 아내들도 따로 애곡할 것이다. 나단 집 족속이 따로 애곡하고, 그 아내들도 따로 애곡할 것이다.
ko.R: 그 땅의 모든 사람이 집안마다 따로 모여 슬퍼할 것이다. 다윗의 집안 사람들이 따로 슬퍼하고, 그 아내들도 따로 슬퍼할 것이다. 나단의 집안 사람들이 따로 슬퍼하고, 그 아내들도 따로 슬퍼할 것이다.

pt.L: E a terra pranteará, clã por clã, cada um à parte: o clã da casa de Davi à parte, e as suas mulheres à parte; o clã da casa de Natã à parte, e as suas mulheres à parte;
pt.B: A terra inteira pranteará, cada clã separadamente: o clã da casa de Davi separadamente, e as suas mulheres separadamente; o clã da casa de Natã separadamente, e as suas mulheres separadamente;
pt.R: Todas as pessoas da terra vão chorar, cada família sozinha. A família de Davi vai chorar sozinha, e as mulheres dela sozinhas. A família de Natã vai chorar sozinha, e as mulheres dela sozinhas.

decisions.choice: clan by clan, each by itself, and their wives by themselves: the whole people in mourning, family by family
decisions.reason: The mourning is not a crowd's but each family's, and the men and the women mourn apart, as was the custom at times of solemn mourning and prayer. The phrase "by itself" is repeated eleven times in verses 12-14, so that no family is left out.

decisions.choice: the house of David, the house of Nathan: the royal line and a branch of it
decisions.reason: Nathan is most likely David's son (2 Samuel 5:14), whose line is traced in Luke 3:31; it may instead be Nathan the prophet. With Levi and Shimei (verse 13), the list names two royal families and two priestly ones: the leaders mourn first.

decisions.choice: by itself (L); on its own (B); by itself, by themselves (R); comma at the end (L, B)
decisions.reason: Every level repeats the phrase as the Hebrew does. The sentence runs on to the end of verse 14, so Literal and Balanced end with a semicolon and go on; Readable makes each family a sentence. "Wives" may also be "women".

decisions.choice: "aparte" (L); "por su lado" (B); "por separado" (R)
decisions.reason: The repeated "alone" is worded the same way through verses 12-14 at each level.

decisions.choice: Each clause closed as its own sentence (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew list runs over verses 12-14; Literal keeps it running with commas, as the English Literal does, while B and R close each verse so that every verse keeps its own content.

decisions.choice: à parte (L); separadamente (B); sozinha(s) (R); Natã
decisions.reason: The phrase is repeated at every level as the Hebrew repeats it (m1), as the English does (r-en-1). "Natã" is the usual Brazilian form of Nathan (m2), as 2 Samuel 5:14 has it.

en.R: The family of Levi will mourn by themselves, and their wives by themselves. The family of Shimei will mourn by themselves, and their wives by themselves.

fr.R: La famille de Lévi pleurera de son côté, et les femmes de cette famille de leur côté. La famille de Shiméï pleurera de son côté, et les femmes de cette famille de leur côté.

vi.L: gia tộc nhà Lê-vi riêng, và vợ họ riêng; gia tộc Si-mê-i riêng, và vợ họ riêng;

sw.R: Jamaa ya Lawi wataomboleza peke yao, na wake zao peke yao. Jamaa ya Shimei wataomboleza peke yao, na wake zao peke yao.

ko.L: 레위 집 족속이 따로, 그들의 아내들이 따로, 시므이 족속이 따로, 그들의 아내들이 따로,
ko.B: 레위 집 족속이 따로 애곡하고, 그 아내들도 따로 애곡할 것이다. 시므이 족속이 따로 애곡하고, 그 아내들도 따로 애곡할 것이다.
ko.R: 레위의 집안 사람들이 따로 슬퍼하고, 그 아내들도 따로 슬퍼할 것이다. 시므이의 집안 사람들이 따로 슬퍼하고, 그 아내들도 따로 슬퍼할 것이다.

pt.L: o clã da casa de Levi à parte, e as suas mulheres à parte; o clã dos simeítas à parte, e as suas mulheres à parte;
pt.B: o clã da casa de Levi separadamente, e as suas mulheres separadamente; o clã dos simeítas separadamente, e as suas mulheres separadamente;
pt.R: A família de Levi vai chorar sozinha, e as mulheres dela sozinhas. A família de Simei vai chorar sozinha, e as mulheres dela sozinhas.

decisions.choice: the house of Levi and the Shimeites: the priestly tribe and one of its families
decisions.reason: Levi is the priestly tribe. Shimei was a grandson of Levi, whose descendants formed one of the families of the Levites (Numbers 3:17-21). As the house of Nathan is a branch of David's house, so the Shimeites are a branch of Levi's.

decisions.choice: The family of Shimei (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says "the family of Shimei" for "the clan of the Shimeites", as it says "family" for each clan.

decisions.choice: "los simeítas" (L, B); "Simeí" (R)
decisions.reason: The Shimeites are "simeítas", as in Numbers 3:21 in Spanish.

decisions.choice: os simeítas (L, B); a família de Simei (R)
decisions.reason: The clan (m1) is "os simeítas", from "Simei", kept apart from "os simeonitas", the tribe of Simeon; Readable says "a família de Simei", as the English Readable does.

records.literal_gloss: all the clans that are left, clans [by] clans, alone, and their wives alone.

en.L: all the clans that are left, clan by clan, each by itself, and their wives by themselves.
en.B: and all the clans that remain, each clan on its own, and their wives on their own.
en.R: All the other family groups will do the same. Each family will mourn by itself, and their wives by themselves.

fr.L: tous les clans qui restent, clan par clan, chacun à part, et leurs femmes à part.
fr.B: et tous les clans qui restent, chaque clan séparément, et leurs femmes séparément.
fr.R: Toutes les autres familles feront de même. Chaque famille pleurera de son côté, et les femmes de leur côté.

es.L: todos los clanes que quedan, clan por clan, cada uno aparte, y sus mujeres aparte.
es.B: y todos los demás clanes, cada clan por su lado, y sus mujeres por su lado.
es.R: Todos los demás grupos de familias harán lo mismo. Cada familia hará duelo por separado, y sus mujeres por separado.

vi.L: mọi gia tộc còn lại, từng gia tộc một, riêng biệt, và vợ họ riêng.

sw.L: koo zote zilizobaki, ukoo kwa ukoo, kila mmoja peke yake, na wake zao peke yao.
sw.B: na koo zote zilizobaki, kila ukoo peke yake, na wake zao peke yao.
sw.R: Jamaa nyingine zote zitafanya vivyo hivyo. Kila jamaa itaomboleza peke yake, na wake zao peke yao.

ko.L: 남은 모든 족속들이 족속마다 따로, 그들의 아내들이 따로 [애곡할 것이다].
ko.B: 그 밖에 남은 모든 족속도 족속마다 따로 애곡하고, 그 아내들도 따로 애곡할 것이다.
ko.R: 다른 모든 집안도 그렇게 할 것이다. 집안마다 따로 슬퍼하고, 그 아내들도 따로 슬퍼할 것이다.

pt.L: todos os clãs que restarem, clã por clã, cada um à parte, e as suas mulheres à parte.
pt.B: e todos os clãs que restarem, cada clã separadamente, e as suas mulheres separadamente.
pt.R: Todas as outras famílias vão fazer o mesmo. Cada família vai chorar sozinha, e as mulheres de cada uma sozinhas.

decisions.choice: all the clans that are left: every other family of the people
decisions.reason: The list ends by including all the rest. Not one family stays out of the mourning of verse 10.

decisions.choice: will do the same (R)
decisions.reason: Readable makes the end of the list a sentence of its own.
